descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-09 step 5 and ER 5; TFA-92587 AC 5 · “New residents (photo or manual) land in All Residents as Follow-up”.

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S03 Add a resident by hand: lands in All Residents as Follow-up

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 New residents, whether added by photo or by hand, land in All Residents as Follow-up (TC-06 defaults). (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-06 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 5; TFA-92587 How it works 5)
  • U1 All Residents is the baseline list of everyone the physician follows at the facility, and every resident in it has a working 'In Today' / '+ Today' toggle. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 1; TFA-92587 How it works 1)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician in Nursing Home

When Tap + (Add Resident) → Full Name 'QA Resident Handadd', Unit / Room 'Oak 9', Encounter Type left as it is → 'Add to Resident Panel' → All Residents

Then The form's Encounter Type starts at Follow-up. The new resident is in All Residents with a Follow-up badge and a toggle

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: the form shows Follow-up selected and nothing else selected; All Residents lists 'QA Resident Handadd' with 'Follow-up' and no New Admission / Consult badge, and mustContain 'In Today ✓' to prove the tab; s03-chart has Follow-up selected on the new resident's own chart (U7). Whether the resident also joins Today's Visits is Q5: recorded, not judged

Where it ran: dev unit U75; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
